summary: Reproduced the Person360 (People profile) crash caught by the app-level ErrorBoundary. Exact RCA obtained from browser console. Bug affects ALL role profiles (partner, customer, merchant) — NOT only partners as the main agent suspected — because the crashing JSX is inside the shared PersonActions component rendered for every role.

ui_bugs.issue: Renders ErrorBoundary fallback on ANY person profile open. TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toUpperCase'). The Email/Push templates <Modal> at lines 898-935 is NOT wrapped in a conditional (unlike the sibling modals for edit/suspend/reset-device/purge/delete). So it renders on the initial mount when `modal` state is still `null` (useState(null) at line 649). Inside that always-mounted Modal, line 934 executes `{modal.toUpperCase()}` and line 898/900/901/907/929/934 all reference `modal` assuming it is 'email' or 'push'. The very first crash point is line 934 — `null.toUpperCase()`.

action_items: Wrap the email/push template <Modal> in Person360.jsx (lines 898-935) with a conditional: `{(modal === 'email' || modal === 'push') && ( ... )}`. The closing `)}` on line 935 already assumes such a wrapper exists — it was clearly dropped in a recent edit. This single change fixes partner AND customer AND merchant profile crashes.

After fix, retest opening a partner, a customer and a merchant profile — Overview tab should render with the PersonActions toolbar (Edit / Suspend / Reset Device / Email / Push / Delete) visible and functional, no ErrorBoundary.
critical_code_review_comments: Person360.jsx line 898: <Modal ...> for Email/Push is rendered unconditionally. Sibling modals (purge/delete/edit/suspend/reset-device) are all wrapped in `{modal === '...' && ( ... )}`. This one lost its wrapper — the trailing `)}` on line 935 is orphaned.
Person360.jsx is 1141 lines — should be split into smaller focused modules (PersonActions, modals, tabs) per code-review guidelines (>700 lines).
Defensive coding: even inside a proper conditional, prefer `(modal || '').toUpperCase()` to survive future refactors.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo seed via 'Login as Admin' one-click on /login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent wraps lines 898-935 with `{(modal === 'email' || modal === 'push') && ( ... )}`, retest by (1) /login -> click [data-testid=demo-admin] -> [data-testid=navgroup-partners] -> [data-testid=nav-partners] -> click first Partner row -> confirm Overview renders with [data-testid=person-actions] visible and no 'Something went wrong' card. (2) Repeat for a customer (navgroup-customers -> nav-customers -> first row) and merchant (nav-merchants -> first row). All three should render cleanly. Backend /admin/people/{role}/{uid}/overview already returns 200 — no backend changes required.

rca of the issue.exact_error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toUpperCase')
rca of the issue.throw_site:
web_panel/src/pages/admin/people/Person360.jsx line 934: `

If the {modal.toUpperCase()} gateway is not configured in the Integration Center, it is delivered as an in-app notification.

`
rca of the issue.root_cause: The Email/Push template <Modal> block (lines 898-935) is missing its conditional wrapper. Sibling modals in the same component are gated with `{modal === 'edit' && ( ... )}`, `{modal === 'suspend' && ( ... )}`, etc. — but this one was left ungated. So on the very first render, when useState(null) makes `modal === null`, the Modal is mounted anyway and its body evaluates `modal.toUpperCase()` on null, throwing synchronously during render. React unmounts the whole Person360 subtree and the app-level ErrorBoundary shows 'Something went wrong'.
rca of the issue.scope: Affects ALL person profile views (partner, customer, merchant) — confirmed by reproducing on both a partner (Raj Kumar) and a customer row. The main agent's hypothesis that only partners crash is INCORRECT; the recently-added device-info/device-history blocks (lines 748-787) are NOT the cause — they are properly gated with `{role === 'partner' && ...}` and did not throw.
reproduction_steps: 4. Click any partner row (e.g. Raj Kumar)
5. Full-page 'Something went wrong' ErrorBoundary card appears within ~500ms; console shows the TypeError above.
6. Same crash reproduces for customers: navgroup-customers -> nav-customers -> click any row.
rca of the issue.fix: In web_panel/src/pages/admin/people/Person360.jsx, wrap lines 898-935 with `{(modal === 'email' || modal === 'push') && (` opening after line 896 blank line and keep the existing `)}` at end of line 935. That single change resolves the crash for all three roles.
